$comment: The Claude Code mods Agentmaster ships inside TerminalApp.dll and loads into every Claude tab it launches (doc/agentmaster/BUNDLED_MODS.md). Listed in --plugin-dir order. After editing a mod here, or this file, run `python tools/bundled-mods/bundled_mods.py gen`; to take a newer copy from the source folder, `sync` first. minClaudeCode is the oldest Claude Code that runs the mod (Agentmaster passes it only to a claude.exe at least that new); summary is the line the cog's Claude tab shows (ASCII, no double quote or backslash: it is written into a C++ literal as it stands). A mod whose "source" is "repo" is Agentmaster's own: its folder here IS its source, and `sync` leaves it alone. A new mod goes last, so the mods before it keep their seats, and TestBundledMods' count and order follow.

mods.name: file-links
mods.summary: Draws the file paths and file names in Claude's replies as clickable file:/// links (a path's folder, then its name), only names it finds on disk; in fullscreen a plain click opens one.

mods.name: better-verbose-bash
mods.summary: Wherever Claude Code draws a shell call's own Bash(command) row, in any view, the reason given for the call becomes the row's header.

mods.name: agentmaster-link
mods.summary: Links the tab to Agentmaster so Telegram's /btw is answered inside the session from its prompt cache (off: a headless fork answers).

mods.name: prompt-cut
mods.summary: Cuts the whole prompt box to the clipboard, pastes expanded, also mid-turn; needs ctrl+x ctrl+x bound to command:prompt-cut (Chat) in your keybindings.json.
